concerns.hazard: busy crossroads with multiple traffic lanes and segregated cycle lanes

concerns.quote: There is no pedestrian guard railing at the junction

concerns.quote: evidence was that in the three years to the end of 2017, there have been 36 reported personal injury collisions within 50 metres of the junction - 17 of which involved pedestrians
